protocols.name: sampling
protocols.description: Mature, non-senescing leaves were sampled and snap-frozen in liquid nitrogen. For canal-1 plants, leaves or leaf parts that were almost entirely white or green were chosen. Samples were stored at -80 °C.

protocols.name: metabolite extraction
protocols.description: Frozen tissue was ground in a mixing mill (Retsch, 1 min at 30 Hz). Aliquots of about 50 mg powder were used for a combined MTBE-based extraction of metabolites, proteins and pigments, following a published protocol.
